claim_text: The Reseller has an exclusive right to distribute LumaMark portable thermal label printers throughout the European Economic Area to consumers through online marketplaces and may sublicense the distribution rights.

restrictions.restriction_description: The grant covers Germany and France only.
Sales are limited to commercial print shops and warehouse operators through the specified business-to-business channels; consumer and online-marketplace sales are not authorized.
The right is non-exclusive, and Supplier may appoint other resellers in the territory.
restrictions.applicable_scope: LumaMark portable thermal label printers in Germany and France

restrictions.restriction_description: The Reseller may not grant sublicenses or appoint sub-resellers.
restrictions.applicable_scope: The distribution rights granted under Section 2.1

contract_text:
Sales License Agreement
2.1 Supplier grants Reseller a non-exclusive right to market and sell the LumaMark portable thermal label printers in Germany and France to commercial print shops and warehouse operators.
2.2 Authorized sales channels are Reseller's direct business-to-business sales and office-equipment resellers approved in writing by Supplier. Sales to consumers and sales through online marketplaces are not authorized.
2.3 Reseller shall not grant sublicenses or appoint sub-resellers. Supplier may appoint other resellers in the territory.

sales_channels: Office-equipment resellers approved in writing by Supplier
contractual_scope.customer_scope: Commercial print shops and warehouse operators; consumers are not authorized customers

verification_rationale: The contract grants only a non-exclusive right in Germany and France for sales to commercial print shops and warehouse operators through specified business-to-business channels. It excludes consumers and online marketplaces and prohibits sublicensing. Each material element of the claim conflicts with the stated terms.
